newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil focus on arb to east, volume thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil focus on arb to east, volume thin.

text.p: The arbitrage to Asia dominated an otherwise quiet NWE gas oil market on Thursday with a 63,000 tonne Russian done into Singapore at mean quotes +37.5 cents a barrel on a notice of readiness basis, traders said.
Heating oil cargo premiums were steady to slightly higher on colder weather, signs of stronger German heating oil demand and the closure of two Indian oil refineries after a pipeline burst.
The closure led to talk that Indian Oil Corp could make a second gas oil tender for January, they added.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures firmed $1.25 to $217.75 following gains on NYMEX in meagre volumes.
Heating oil was offered at Dec IPE +$6 into Germany, up some $2, and offered at +$10 into Rostock. One major European trader fixed gas oil to India and others were exploring this option.
Barges were fairly quiet with premiums around unchanged. A barge traded at Dec IPE+$2.25 for early Dec and +$2 for prompt.
Barge supply remained very slow because of absorption of capacity by the record high November IPE delivery.
The IPE said it and the London Clearing House were doing their utmost to resolve problems in the delivery. It added it was confident the complications could be sorted out.
